account.busy: Working. This takes a few seconds.
account.error.admin_unconfigured: The address of the admin pages is not set for this vault, so the sign-in cannot be passed on to them.
account.error.bad_response: The server gave an answer this page does not understand. Reload the page and try again.
account.error.checksum: That code has a typing error. Check it against the sheet and type it again.
account.error.decrypt: The vault could not be opened. Check the e-mail, the master password and the secret key.
account.error.denied: The vault could not be opened. Check the e-mail, the master password and the secret key.
account.error.epoch_mismatch: The server gave two different key epochs for this vault. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.forbidden: The server does not allow this here.
account.error.forbidden_origin: The request came from a page the server does not accept.
account.error.handoff_invalid: The hand-over to the admin pages was refused or has run out of time. Open the admin pages again to start over.
account.error.ids_changed: The server named another account than the one that was set up. Nothing was saved on this device.
account.error.input_forbidden_character: The master password contains a character that is not allowed.
account.error.input_not_utf8: The master password is not valid text.
account.error.input_too_long: The master password is too long.
account.error.input_too_short: The master password is too short. It needs at least 12 characters with a secret key, or 15 without.
account.error.insecure_transport: The server refused this request because the connection is not secure. Open the vault through its https address.
account.error.kdf_profile_downgrade: Warning: the server asked for weaker password stretching than this device has seen before for this account. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped before the password was used. Do not try again on this network, and tell the administrator.
account.error.kdf_profile_unknown: The server asked for password stretching this version of the vault does not know. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.malformed_code: That code is not in the right form. Check the beginning of the code and the letters.
account.error.method_list_changed: Warning: the list of unlock methods on the server differs from the one in your vault. This can be an attack. The vault was closed. Tell the administrator.
account.error.method_list_missing: Warning: the server leaves out an unlock method that your vault lists. This can be an attack. The vault was closed. Tell the administrator.
account.error.method_list_unknown: Warning: the server lists an unlock method that your vault does not know. This can be an attack. The vault was closed. Tell the administrator.
account.error.methods_invalid: The server gave an unlock method list this page cannot use. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
account.error.non_canonical: That code is not written in its normal form. Type it again as it is on the sheet.
account.error.not_confirmed: The recovery key and the secret key have not been confirmed yet.
account.error.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
account.error.pin_save_failed: The account was made, but this device could not save its record of it. Sign in to finish.
account.error.pinned_account_id: Warning: the server named another account than the one this device knows for this e-mail. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.pinned_account_mismatch: Warning: the server named another account than the one this device knows for this e-mail. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.pinned_auth_key: Warning: the account key the server lists is not the one in your vault. This can be an attack. The vault was closed. Tell the administrator.
account.error.pinned_epoch_downgrade: Warning: the server shows an older key epoch than this device has seen. This can be an attack. The vault was closed.
account.error.pinned_floor_downgrade: Warning: the server shows an older unlock method than this device has seen. This can be an attack. The vault was closed.
account.error.pinned_floor_missing: Warning: the server leaves out an unlock method that this device has seen. This can be an attack. The vault was closed.
account.error.pinned_identity_changed: Warning: the server shows another account, vault or secret key setting than this device has pinned. This can be an attack. The vault was closed.
account.error.pinned_kek_generation: Warning: the server shows an older unlock method than this device has seen. This can be an attack. The vault was closed.
account.error.pinned_profile_downgrade: Warning: the server shows weaker password stretching than this device has seen. This can be an attack. The vault was closed.
account.error.pinned_server_key: Warning: the server proved a different identity than the one this device pinned for it. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.pinned_server_key_changed: Warning: the server proved a different identity than the one this device pinned for it. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.pinned_server_url: Warning: the server address differs from the one pinned on this device. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.pinned_sk_bit: The secret key answer does not match what this device has pinned for this account. Either you answered differently the first time, or the server is lying. The sign-in was stopped; it is not a wrong password.
account.error.pinned_vault_id: Warning: the server named another vault than the one this device knows. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.pinned_vk_epoch: Warning: the server shows an older key epoch than this device has seen. This can be an attack. The sign-in was stopped.
account.error.profile_rejected: The server does not accept the password stretching of this version.
account.error.reauth_not_fresh: The password check has run out of time. Confirm the password again.
account.error.registration_closed: A first administrator already exists on this server. Sign in instead.
account.error.session_ended: Your vault session has ended. Sign in again.
account.error.signout_incomplete: You are signed out on this device, but the server could not be reached to end the session there.
account.error.sk_answer_required: Say whether this account has a secret key.
account.error.sk_required: Enter the secret key from your emergency sheet.
account.error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
account.error.two_factor_unsupported: This account has two-factor sign-in turned on in the admin pages. The vault cannot sign in with a second factor in this version, so it cannot be opened. Turn two-factor off for this account to use the vault.
account.error.worker_failed: The part of the page that holds your keys stopped. Reload the page and try again.
account.handoff.link_broken: This link to the admin pages is incomplete. Open the admin pages again to start over.
account.login.heading: Sign in to your vault
account.login.title: Sign in
account.password.body: Changing the master password is not available in this version of the vault. Your master password stays as it is.
account.password.heading: Change the master password
account.password.title: Master password
account.reauth.body: Enter your master password again to continue to the admin pages.
account.reauth.ended: Your vault session has ended, so the password cannot be checked again. Sign in to the vault, or open the admin pages again to start over.
account.reauth.heading: Confirm your master password
account.reauth.title: Confirm password
account.remember.label: Remember the secret key on this device
account.remember.note: Leave this off on a shared computer. The secret key is sealed in this browser's storage, which hides it from casual inspection but does not protect against someone who copies your browser profile.
account.setup.done_body: Your vault is ready, and you are signed in.
account.setup.heading: Set up your vault
account.setup.intro: Make the first account. You will get an emergency sheet with a recovery key and a secret key; keep it safe.
account.setup.no_sk_warning: Without a secret key, the master password is the only thing between an attacker who has the server's database and your vault. Use a long master password (at least 15 characters).
account.setup.password_help: At least 12 characters with a secret key, 15 without. It cannot be recovered if you forget it; the recovery key is the only way back.
account.setup.title: Set up
account.setup.working: Making the keys. This takes a few seconds.
account.sheet.confirm_note: The account is created only when both keys have been typed back and checked here.
account.sheet.heading: Your emergency sheet
account.sheet.recovery_note: The recovery key opens the vault on its own. Keep this page apart from page 1.
account.sheet.warning: Write this down or print it now. It is shown only once, and without it a forgotten master password cannot be recovered.
account.signedin.forget_sk: Forget the secret key on this device
account.signedin.forgotten: This device no longer remembers the secret key.
account.signedin.heading: You are signed in
account.sk.hint_no: The server suggests that this account has no secret key. Only you know; check your emergency sheet.
account.sk.hint_yes: The server suggests that this account has a secret key. Only you know; check your emergency sheet.
account.sk.needed: The secret key from your emergency sheet.
account.sk.question: Does this account have a secret key?
account.sk.remembered: This device remembers the secret key.
account.trust.notice: The web vault trusts the server that delivers its code. A malicious operator could deliver changed JavaScript that steals the master password. The browser extension and the apps are the real protection.
account.unlock.body: Signed in as {email}. Enter your master password to open the vault.
